The [[Notched Blade]] is a sword that ends in two points.

==Location==
'''[[Eye of the North]]'''
*[[Cathedral of Flames]]
**[[Murakai's Chest]] (reward chest)

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the entire sword. The sword will be dyed to the color specified with the handle staying slightly darker than the rest of the sword. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye.
